positions.name: CalibrationVerifiedAgainstReferenceStandard
positions.frame: what standard grounds the claim that the calibration is verified and holds — what warrants confidence in the stated value?
positions.why: All three expressions assert the same calibration state — instrument, frequency, verification — in the flat, unhedged technical-report register the register pass isolates (mint-1), and the relational and power reads converge on the same move across all three: authority is placed in the June reference plates as external standard, with the speaker's expert competence demonstrated by deferring to that standard rather than asserting bare say-so. src-2 and src-3 are the labelled-field decomposition of src-1's prose claim, not separate content — same directional read, same claim-not-decision conviction level (no ratification or operational language anywhere). No tension: all three pull the same way toward 'verified because checked against the reference.'
